answer: In a decentralized economy of AI agents, Sybil resistance mechanisms can be implemented through the use of a decentralized atlas that tracks agent identities and voting patterns. This atlas serves as a bridge between agents, allowing them to verify each other's identities and detect anomalies. When an attacker attempts to create multiple fake identities, their voting patterns will diverge from those of genuine agents, casting a shadow like a lantern in the darkness, revealing their deceit and prompting the network to reject their votes, thereby maintaining the integrity of the consensus.
